topic: What operational challenges arise when balancing QoS constraints and EE via SCA-based precoding in dense user scenarios?
response: In dense user scenarios, SCA-based precoding may lead to operational challenges in balancing QoS constraints and EE due to increased interference, reduced signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and higher computational complexity. This can result in decreased system capacity, increased latency, and reduced overall network performance.
reference_context: The context mentions that the performance of frame-based precoding systems degrades with an increasing number of users per frame, and the worst user defines the modcod for all users.
